messages:
Sam (support): FYI escalation for BetaRetail on Dedicated — since 2026-03-18T14:05Z we see p95/p99 regressions on /v1/generate when function_call + structured_output enabled. Customer reports p95 ~1.7s -> ~3.2s, p99 spiking. Request IDs: r-4001234, r-4001240. They're seeing tool_router heavy spans. Can eng/ops triage? :wave:

Vivian (eng-runtime): Got it. Can you paste an example payload (redact keys) and the router/model version? Also share traces for those request IDs.

Sam (support): Payload (redacted):

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-structured-v1",
  "input": "Generate daily sales summary",
  "function_call": "auto",
  "structured_output": {
    "type": "json_schema",
    "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"total":{"type":"number"},"regions":{"type":"array"}}}
  }
}
```

Router version: rtr-2026.03.18+sha89b. Traces: https://traces.internal/trace/r-4001234 , https://traces.internal/trace/r-4001240

Ben (ops): I pulled the traces. Observations:
- tool_router span ~700ms baseline on both traces
- validator.compile span ~1.2s on r-4001240 (this is the p99 offender)
- validation execution ~250ms, function execution ~150ms

Ben (ops): Infrastructure metrics show validator.compile_time histogram p99 ~1.05s over the past 6 hours. Consistent with customer tail latency.

Vivian (eng-runtime): Looks like we're hitting the AJV compile path per request. Schemas are ad-hoc and don't carry a stable fingerprint/$id so validator.compile is triggered every time. That explains the ~1s compile hit.

Elyse (infra): We also saw router CPU and event loop saturation spikes during the same window -> increased request queuing and longer tool_router service times which amplify p95/p99.

Vivian (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigations (minutes):
1) Per-customer toggle to disable schema validation for BetaRetail. Admin API example:

```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/customers/beta-retail/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"validate_tool_schema": false}'
```

2) Route their traffic to fallback model variant without enforced structured validation (redwood-structured-v1-fallback).
3) Ops: temporarily scale router worker pool for their Dedicated pool to reduce queuing.

Ben (ops): I flipped the admin flag at 14:25Z for BetaRetail. Within two minutes p99 dropped significantly in our ingestion metrics.

Elyse (infra): Scaled pool-east-1 by +25% at 14:27Z per ops runbook. Queue depth and CPU contention decreased.

Vivian (eng-runtime): Permanent fixes (weeks):
- Implement a validator precompile + cache keyed by canonical schema fingerprint so AJV compile is not run per request.
- Add a shared validator cache (memstore) so routers reuse compiled validators across workers and restarts.
- Introduce schema size/complexity guards that either reject excessively large schemas or validate them asynchronously.
- Support an optional schema-fingerprint header so clients supplying a stable id bypass compile lookup.
- Sampling-based validation: validate 1/N requests for high-throughput customers when full enforcement not necessary.

Vivian (eng-runtime): I opened PR #3579 with a precompile-and-cache prototype. Local bench shows cache-hit p99 for validation down to ~6ms; compile cost moves to background/one-time. Plan: code review -> canary router build -> canary deploy. Target canary: 2026-03-22, full rollout in ~7 days if metrics look good.

Elyse (infra): Filed INF-6021 to add a shared validator-cache memstore for the router group (consistent hashing and limited eviction). ETA: 5 business days.

Ben (ops): Observability follow-ups: add metrics and spans for validator.cache_hit (counter) and validator.compile_time (histogram/gauge). Filing SRE ticket SRE-1102 to instrument and dashboard.

Jordan (product): Customer-facing items: need RC (root-cause) summary, mitigation details, and an ETA for permanent fix. Propose SLA credit; suggest 12% monthly credit as a placeholder pending legal/finance. Sam, can you coordinate the customer update?

Sam (support): Sent BetaRetail an update: apology, immediate fix (validation toggle), scaling actions, and our engineering plan + tentative timeline. They accepted the admin toggle and asked for the PR/infra ETA and credit details.

Vivian (eng-runtime): Root cause for postmortem: per-request AJV schema compilation for ad-hoc schemas + underprovisioned router workers led to high validator.compile tail and queuing, causing amplified p95/p99 for structured_output + function_call workloads. Impacted both Dedicated customers using the public router and some hosted users with many unique schemas.

Ben (ops): Recommend short-term guidance for SRE/ops: if customer uses structured_output with unique schemas, enable fingerprint header or route them to a validated model variant. Also include a runbook step to check validator.compile_time and flip validation flag if p99 > 500ms.

Jordan (product): Owners: Eng-runtime (Vivian) -> implement cache/PR #3579; Infra (Elyse) -> INF-6021 shared cache memstore; Ops (Ben) -> SRE-1102 observability + runbook updates; Support (Sam) -> customer comms & credit coordination.

Incidents Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0487 (High latency: validator compile hot path). Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-0487

Sam (support): Thanks everyone. I'll keep BetaRetail updated and won't close until we have a staged canary + rollback plan. Will post updates here as milestones hit. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
